why: This is a reusable educational knowledge-tracing methodology for choosing full, no, or partial pooling across learner groups, not an instructional pattern or course design.
name: Three pooling formulations for Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (standard, multi, and hierarchical)

why: This is an application and task-selection variant of Bayesian Knowledge Tracing’s canonical two-state hidden-Markov learner model, so its evidence belongs on that page rather than constituting a new theory.

claims.verifier: The claim directly tests BKT-based adaptive task selection and reports improved learning outcomes compared with random selection.
